## Technical Competencies & Specializations

### Frontend & Web Architecture
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: Next.js, React 19, Vite, TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext).
- **Styling & Motion**: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS3 Modern Layouts, Framer Motion, GSAP, Responsive Mobile-First Design.
- **Web Standards & Performance**: 100/100 Core Web Vitals, Semantic HTML5, Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

### Backend & Distributed Systems
- **Languages & Frameworks**: Java, Spring Boot, Python, Django, Node.js, Express.
- **APIs & Architecture**: High-throughput RESTful APIs, Microservices, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Session & JWT Auth, Third-Party Integrations.
- **Databases & ORM**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase, Hibernate/JPA, Redis, Schema Design, Query Optimization.

### Mobile & System Engineering
- **Mobile Ecosystem**: Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftData, iOS Native Development, Offline-First Architecture.
- **DevOps & Infrastructure**: Vercel, Render, Railway, Netlify, Docker, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare.

---

## Architecture & Engineering Philosophy

1. **Business Process First**: Understand domain workflows, edge cases, and business constraints before writing code.
2. **Modular & Clean Architecture**: High cohesion, loose coupling, strict end-to-end type safety, and self-documenting codebases.
3. **Zero-Bloat Performance**: Sub-second initial loads, strict layout-shift elimination, and 100/100 Lighthouse benchmark standard.
4. **Production-Ready Delivery**: Full lifecycle ownership from discovery and system design to automated deployment, monitoring, and long-term maintainability.

## Highlighted Production Systems

### 1. AC Management App (Air Conditioning Services ERP & Operations)
- **Live Demo**: https://ac-management-webapp.onrender.com
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/YuvrajCodes11/AC_management_WEBAPP
- **Stack**: Python, Django, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Render
- **Overview**: Full-stack operations ERP engineered with role-based access for CEOs, managers, and service technicians. Manages customer tickets, technician dispatching, BOQ material issues, AMC contract renewals, inventory tracking, and executive business analytics.

### 2. BLUE (Ocean Intelligence & Livelihood Ecosystem)
- **Live Demo**: https://blue-black-gamma.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/YuvrajCodes11/BLUE
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
- **Overview**: Centralized ocean intelligence portal for fisheries, Beach Management Units (BMUs), and marine conservation organizations to monitor coastal community livelihoods, track marine resources, and collaborate on ocean conservation.

### 3. The Tokyo Archive (Marc Jacobs Tokyo Capsule Collection)
- **Live Demo**: https://the-tokyo-archive.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/YuvrajCodes11/the-tokyo-archive
- **Stack**: React, Vite, GSAP, CSS3, Vercel
- **Overview**: High-converting interactive digital showcase for the Marc Jacobs Tokyo capsule collection featuring 300 numbered pieces, dynamic Japanese typography, and a graphic-novel narrative aesthetic with smooth GSAP timelines.

### 4. A King & A Queen (Premium Fashion E-Commerce Platform)
- **Live Demo**: https://e-commerce-iota-smoky.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/YuvrajCodes11
- **Stack**: React, JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Supabase
- **Overview**: Scalable retail e-commerce platform with secure customer authentication, dynamic catalog filtering, cart/checkout workflows, payment endpoints, and an administrative order and inventory management dashboard.
